run_blacklist_ingress_ips: run the script to blacklist IPs from a file on a network device using py2bpf
build_blacklist_maps: build eBPF maps from a file of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses for ingress filtering
compile_filter: compile a drop function that checks packet source IPs against blacklist maps
clear_ingress_filter: clear the existing ingress filter on a specified network device
review_drop_fn: review the drop function that loads source addresses and checks them against blacklist maps
